reference.precision: At least 120 decimal digits during reference generation, rounded to IEEE-754 binary64 literals
reference.parameters: Bessel small and large arguments; modified Bessel domain and scale cases; incomplete and complete elliptic integrals including Pi; Jacobi quarter periods; Ei/E1 tails; convergent 2F1 parameter and argument fixtures
reference.license: Repository-authored generators and fixtures under MIT; mathematical reference material is cited from NIST DLMF
reference.regeneration: Run the generate_*_data.py tools referenced by each include header, then run the cited special-function test units

families.input_domain: Finite real-double explicit-form initial-value systems with smooth right-hand sides over the integration interval, dense state Jacobians, and tolerances for which the bounded step and Newton iteration converges.

budget.metric: Fixture-specific endpoint, interpolation, and event bounds; the Robertson endpoint uses 20*(rtol*abs(reference)+10*atol) per component (maximum allowed state deviation 2.2e-3).
budget.unit: state units; event-time bounds are separately asserted

reference.method: Closed-form forced-stiff scalar solution and published Robertson kinetics endpoint values
reference.source: The repository spec cites the SUNDIALS cvRoberts_dns.c example: https://github.com/LLNL/sundials/blob/main/examples/cvode/serial/cvRoberts_dns.c
reference.precision: IEEE-754 binary64; published Robertson decimal values are represented as binary64 literals
reference.parameters: Forced equation y'=-1000*(y-cos(t))-sin(t), y(0)=0; Robertson system at t=4e10 with y0=[1,0,0], rtol=1e-4 and atols=[1e-8,1e-14,1e-6]
reference.license: Repository-authored test fixture under the project license; upstream SUNDIALS source is cited and no third-party implementation code is copied
reference.regeneration: Run TestNumericalModelling. Review the cited SUNDIALS endpoint fixture and evaluate the forced-problem identity y(t)=cos(t)-exp(-1000*t); no network access is needed at test time.

assertions: non-stiff result agrees with explicit solver
tests.kind: closed-form stiff endpoint and dense-output accuracy, tolerance refinement, event location, analytic/automatic/finite-difference Jacobians, backward integration, and non-stiff comparison
published Robertson reference endpoint with per-component absolute/relative tolerance weighting

assertions: Newton failure is reported as breakdown
tests.kind: invalid-input, iteration-limit, Newton-breakdown, non-finite-output, and reentrancy checks

edge_cases: Forward and backward integration, scalar and component tolerances, interpolation, and directional event localization are covered.
Finite-difference, analytic, and automatic Jacobian modes are tested against the same forced-stiff reference.
Missing or malformed Jacobians, zero combined tolerance, non-finite or wrong-dimension derivatives, step exhaustion, and Newton failure have explicit outcomes.
The Robertson kinetics system exercises a three-component stiff trajectory at t=4e10; sparse Jacobians, mass matrices, DAEs, and large-scale solves are outside the supported domain.
